paragraphs: Yochanan ben Berokah: Avot 4:4. In the Mishnah: Eruvin 8:2, 10:15; Pesachim 7:9 (82a); Sukkah 4:6 (45a); Yevamot 6:6; Ketubbot 2:1; Bava Kamma 10:2; Bava Batra 8:5 (130a); Shevuot 7:7 (45a); Bekhorot 8:10; Kelim 17:11. His colleague Rabbi Elazar Chisma: they went to greet Rabbi Yehoshua at Pekiin, Chagigah 3a and Tosefta, Sotah, chapter 7. His son Rabbi Yishmael was Rabbi’s colleague. He went to Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri; see his entry.
